title: Every module is a small directed colimit of finitely presented modules
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $Q$ an $R$-module. There exist a small nonempty directed partially ordered set $I$ (any two indices have a common upper bound), finitely presented $R$-modules $Q_i$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module] for $i\in I$, $R$-linear maps $a_{ij}:Q_i\to Q_j$ for $i\le j$ with $a_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$ and $a_{jk}a_{ij}=a_{ik}$, and $R$-linear maps $a_i:Q_i\to Q$ with $a_j a_{ij}=a_i$, such that $(Q,(a_i)_i)$ is a colimit of this diagram in the category of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

lean.statement: theorem exists_small_directed_colimit_finitePresentation (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (Q : Type v) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] : ∃ (I : Type (max u v)) (p : PartialOrder I) (n : Nonempty I) (d : IsDirected I (p.toLE.le)), ∃ (F : @Functor I (@Preorder.smallCategory I p.toPreorder) (ModuleCat.{v} R) inferInstance), (∀ i, Module.FinitePresentation R (F.obj i)) ∧ ∃ (c : Cocone F), c.pt = ModuleCat.of R Q ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit c)

reviewed_lean.note: F1 (H3): delivered `I : Type u` (ring universe) makes the statement false for Q : Type v with v > u: the colimit of finitely presented stages indexed by a Type u set has cardinality at most a lift of a Type u cardinal (counterexample R = ℤ, Q = Type →₀ ℤ). Stacks 00HA's index set and the sibling node's proof live in universe max u v; fixed to `I : Type (max u v)`. F2 (H8): theorem docstring lacked the node's proof; added it step by step with the 058G source place. Every other clause matches the node (nonempty directed partial order, functor laws, Module.FinitePresentation per stage, cocone with vertex ModuleCat.of R Q, IsColimit). No Mathlib or project duplicate; the sibling node has no lean record. Imports, line lengths, docstrings and record fields are fine; proof is sorry.
